$comment: Each fixture in this directory must be rejected with the listed error. Producers can use these to prove their adapter never emits a payload Pal will refuse; Pal uses them to prove ingest refuses one.

activity-day-not-a-real-date.json.why: 2026-02-30 has the right shape but is not a date, which usually means a timezone bug upstream.

config-version-zero.json.why: config_version is monotonic and 1-based; 0 would sort below every real revision.

derived-event-type.json.why: Engine-derived events are never ingestable. An integration that could POST level_up could grant its own levels.

eligible-days-out-of-range.json.why: Version 1 models a Monday-Friday week, so 7 eligible days cannot be true.

envelope-leaks-debug-object.json.why: Nested debugging context is outside the closed event envelope and may carry accidental personal data.

envelope-leaks-email.json.why: A raw email must be rejected even when it is outside metadata; the entire event envelope is privacy-allow-listed.

envelope-leaks-raw-student-id.json.why: A producer cannot attach its internal learner identifier beside the pseudonymous learner_id.

envelope-leaks-title.json.why: Human-readable classroom or assignment titles are not part of the event envelope.

kind-not-allowed-in-v1.json.why: Only 'assignment' is defined in version 1. Widening the enum is a contract change, not a payload choice.

invalid-term-timezone.json.why: Term boundaries require a valid IANA timezone so Pal changes terms at the classroom's authoritative local midnight.

legacy-event-type.json.why: The prototype's assignment.completed is not part of the v1 vocabulary; it reaches ingest on the legacy path instead.

metadata-leaks-assignment-title.json.why: The privacy boundary is enforced by rejecting unknown keys, not by trusting producers to omit them.

missing-period-key.json.why: Without period_key Pal would have to infer the academic week from delivery time, which is exactly what the contract forbids.

occurred-at-local-time.json.why: occurred_at is an absolute instant. Offsets are rejected so no consumer has to guess a timezone.

partial-term-calendar.json.why: Term identity, range, and week position form one authoritative calendar assertion and cannot be sent partially.

raw-learner-email.json.why: learner_id must be a pseudonymous token. An email is both non-URL-safe and a privacy violation.

reversed-term-range.json.why: An academic term cannot end before it starts.

session-started-with-metadata.json.why: platform.session.started carries no metadata, so an IP address cannot ride along with it.

timing-enum-not-allowed.json.why: 'excused' is an academic state Pika owns; it is not a completion timing Pal can interpret.

term-week-count-out-of-range.json.why: Pip's adaptive story supports terms from 6 through 24 instructional weeks.

unsupported-schema-version.json.why: Pal must ship support for a version before a producer emits it. This failure is not retryable.

week-index-exceeds-term.json.why: A period's authoritative week position must fall inside its declared term length.

week-start-outside-term.json.why: An authoritative instructional week must start inside its declared term range.
